description: Structured output schema for the Redacta on-device scan lane. Used verbatim as the on-device promptOptions.responseConstraint (a plain JSON schema is accepted there per the Firebase docs). The scan lane has no cloud configuration at all, so this shape is the on-device answer shape; js/hybrid.js carries an identical copy as SCAN_SCHEMA and js/sim.js returns the same shape in simulation mode.

entities.description: Every span of personal or sensitive data found in the document, in document order.

value.description: The exact text span as it appears in the document.

localSummary.description: One or two plain sentences describing the document, generated on-device. Must not repeat any entity value.

sensitivityScore.description: 0-100 aggregate exposure score for the document as a whole.

title: RedactaEntityExtraction
